static_traits.name: Chen Jin
static_traits.family_status: Living with one's parents and two young younger siblings
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychological problems or treatment history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, relatively good logic, able to concretely describe situations and feelings; emotions inclined toward anxiety and self-doubt; open attitude toward exploration and practice, relatively high cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: I believe that missing one shot in today's football match means I can never become a professional football player. This thought brings feelings of failure and self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of failure are affecting my performance on the field and my overall physical and mental state. I really want to get past this hurdle, so that I can feel better both in games and about myself.
growth_experiences: Last month, after joining a new team, pressure to perform well in the new environment led the client to begin experiencing feelings of failure and self-doubt; after missing a crucial shot in a recent game, these feelings worsened markedly, gradually developing into strongly doubting their own ability whenever an error occurred in each game and training session.

In terms of team relationships, although there are teammates and a coach to communicate with, the client finds it hard to open up for fear of being seen as 'fragile', resulting in affected relationships with teammates. Self-doubt further affects sleep and training motivation.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / I will fail
My worth depends on whether I perform perfectly

special_situations.event: 比赛中错失一次关键射门
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one mistake occurs at a critical moment, it means I am not capable enough and cannot become a professional player
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles training and repeatedly recalls mistakes to avoid repeating them
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Not making it this time proves I have no hope of becoming a professional player

special_situations.event: Any single mistake occurring in competitions and training
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot do perfectly in every round, then I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: On the field, excessively self-monitors, taking avoiding mistakes as the core goal rather than engaging in the match
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once I make a mistake, it shows I am completely no good

special_situations.event: After joining a new team, needing to adapt and demonstrate ability as a newcomer
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot quickly show excellent performance, teammates and the coach will think I am not capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Suppresses vulnerability and unease, does not express them to teammates, relying on self-forcing and extra training to prove the self
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have no place on this team; they will look down on me

special_situations.event: Thinking about future career development (for example performing in a higher-level league)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot control mistakes now, the future will only get worse and worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to control outcomes by training at higher intensity or repeatedly rehearsing mistake scenes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely play worse and worse in the future; I can never become a professional player

special_situations.event: After teammates or the coach observe one's performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' approval of me determines whether I have worth and a future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly comparing oneself with others and seeking recognition, avoiding expressing vulnerability to maintain image
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If they think I am weak, then I really am worthless

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, proving oneself to be a capable player worthy of affirmation
core_conflict.fear: Fears being seen as weak or a failure, worrying about being belittled, rejected, and losing belonging
defense_goal: Avoids criticism through perfect performance and harsh self-demands
Staying silent and not asking for help to avoid exposing vulnerability
Turning negative emotions toward oneself to maintain relationship stability

object_relations.self_representation: An unqualified newcomer/failure who constantly needs to prove oneself
object_relations.object_representation: Others who judge and find fault at any moment (teammates/coaches)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to express real feelings to teammates or coach and seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes the other person will regard them as weak and unable to withstand pressure (transferential projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious and vague tone, avoids directly expressing vulnerable feelings, describes training and technical details more, and reduces emotional disclosure.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Being noticed or receiving feedback from others after making a mistake in a match or training
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turns dissatisfaction and anger about performance onto the self, concluding the self is worthless (self-attack)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses self-blaming and deprecating words (such as 'it is all my fault'), with a hurried tone and frequent apologies, actively lowering self-worth in pursuit of 'safety'.

manifestations: Worrying about being seen as weak by teammates and not daring to open up, difficulty seeking help
Feeling judged in the new team; inner experiences are hard for others to understand
Internalizing self-doubt and bearing it alone, avoiding building more authentic connections
outcomes: Reduced interpersonal support, strained team relationships
Worsening anxiety and self-doubt, sleep affected, decreased motivation to practice

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: When feelings of failure arise, does not express them or seek help from teammates, but endures by practicing more and being hard on the self
In conversations, talking more about technique and training, less expressing real vulnerable emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believes teammates will regard them as a 'weak person', and therefore avoids open communication
When being noticed, presuming others' negative evaluation, thus worsening defense and alienation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: In competitions, constantly self-monitoring and worrying about making mistakes, affecting engagement and performance
Equating one mistake with overall incompetence, thus limiting expression and interaction

exception_events.target_problem: Once a mistake occurs in games or training, the client usually quickly falls into self-negation and feelings of failure, which in turn affects focus and performance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When completing an outstanding play or shot in certain rounds, the client experiences brief confidence and positive evaluation in the moment, with attention more focused on the game rather than the mistakes.
exception_events.reason: Clues: obtained clear success feedback in the moment and briefly focused on present execution, reducing rumination about potential mistakes and self-criticism, resulting in a different experience.

positive_force: Has an objective competitive foundation and occasional high-quality play (successful plays can bring brief confidence)
An environment with teammates and a coach who can provide potential support
Has motivation to seek help and an open attitude toward cognitive restructuring and practice
Able to persist in training, with willingness to commit to action
negative_force: Marked negative cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, overgeneralization, and mind reading
Excessive self-monitoring and high sensitivity to external judgment, relying on external recognition to define self-worth
Avoids seeking help for worry of being seen as weak, making it hard for the support system to function
Sleep is affected and motivation to practice declines, forming a negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: In games and training, strong feelings of failure and self-doubting automatic thoughts appear (accompanied by anxiety and scattered attention)
antecedent: A mistake occurs in a competition or training
Scenes of being noticed or evaluated in a new team environment
target_behavior.core_reason: Interprets a single mistake as evidence of overall lack of ability and inevitable future failure; inner value overly depends on perfect performance and external recognition
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged and feelings of shame, attempting to gain a sense of control through self-blame and self-monitoring
target_behavior.consequence: Focus declines, performance worsens, sleep is affected, practice motivation decreases, and relationships with teammates are strained

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding expressing true feelings to teammates and seeking support
antecedent: Situations of feeling seen as weak or worrying that others do not understand
After mistakes, self-doubt arises and negative evaluations from others are anticipated
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries that exposing vulnerability will lead to being belittled or rejected, projects self-criticism and fear as others' judgment
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible shame and negation, maintaining superficial safety and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Emotional burden is internalized, social support decreases, interpersonal relationships are strained, and the problem is maintained or even worsens
